standards.description: Electric energy transfers through a complete circuit; a series loop transfers it to every component.
standards.traceDetail: The shared loop drives all three bulbs together.

standards.description: Electric current through components in series is the same at all points; charge is conserved.
standards.traceDetail: Identical ammeter reads at each bulb prove the single current.

standards.description: Circuit current and voltage division follow series topology; a break anywhere stops the loop.
standards.traceDetail: Removing bulb B opens the loop, showing the series survival rule.
